summary: Fifteen CAISO transmission owners (the Joint PTOs) ask FERC to hold the 60-day show cause response deadline in abeyance for 90 days, to November 16, 2026, so each can prepare section 205 TO Tariff filings coordinated with CAISO.
ask: Hold the deadline to respond to the show cause order and briefing questions in abeyance until November 16, 2026.

points.point: The Joint PTOs seek a 90-day full abeyance of the 60-day response deadline to prepare section 205 TO Tariff filings.
points.quote: The Joint PTOs seek a 90-day full abeyance of the current 60-day deadline to respond to all issues raised in the OSC

points.point: Tariff changes will vary by PTO because some serve load and others do not.
points.quote: some PTOs serve load while others do not, for example

points.point: Filing on August 17 would likely conflict with CAISO's design, so the Joint PTOs want a coordinated set of filings.
points.quote: Filing tariff revisions on August 17 would require the Joint PTOs to submit tariff provisions that would likely conflict with the CAISO’s design

points.point: The Joint PTOs read the co-location, flexible service and proximate generation findings as aimed at the CAISO Tariff.
points.quote: the third, fourth, and fifth issues – co-located load, flexible services, and proximate load – are primarily directed at the CAISO Tariff

points.point: CAISO's Board acts October 28, so CAISO Tariff revisions are unlikely to be final until near November 16.
points.quote: The CAISO does not currently plan to seek Board approval until October 28, just over two and a half weeks before a 90-day extended filing deadline

points.point: The expected filings cover study, application and operational procedures plus transparency, cost recovery, financial security and rate treatment.
points.quote: present revisions to the TO Tariffs to include study, application, and operational procedures for the interconnection of large loads

points.point: The Joint PTOs also ask that the briefing question deadline be tolled for 90 days.
points.quote: The Joint PTOs also request to toll the deadline to respond to the briefing questions for 90 days

throughLine.text: Requests the up-to-90-day abeyance option in the E-10 CAISO show cause order and previews TO Tariff filings on the study process and the pro forma cost recovery agreement. FERC granted it August 14, 2026.
